subject: 40 Century Street Condemnation Hearing
overview: The Board of Health voted to stay a condemnation order for a residential property to allow for safety repairs and heard a comprehensive report on the city's health equity and outreach programs.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the May 2026 meeting.

items.title: 40 Century Street Sanitary Code Hearing
items.summary: The board voted for a 30-day stay of a non-emergency condemnation at 40 Century Street to allow a landlord to repair 22 violations, including conditions deemed to endanger such as missing handrails and electrical issues. Counsel for the landlord and the elderly tenants agreed that relocation would be detrimental due to the tenants' ongoing medical treatments.

items.title: Office of Prevention and Outreach Presentation
items.summary: Staff presented a review of community engagement initiatives, including multilingual outreach, ESOL council coordination, youth employment programs, and Haitian senior social groups.

items.title: Reportable Disease Update
items.summary: The public health nurse reported that influenza rates are comparable to the five-year average while COVID-19 cases have declined, and provided updates on available booster doses and vaccines.

items.title: Recognition of Kathleen Chabonier
items.summary: The board recognized member Kathleen Chabonier with a mayoral citation for over a decade of service upon her retirement.

items.title: Mass General Brigham Health Van
items.summary: The health department is coordinating with Mass General Brigham to bring a mobile health van to the city in August for primary care screenings and checkups.
